changelog.message: op created for native Node N-API-backed UVC camera hardware controller
changelog.author: Antigravity

summary: Controls UVC camera hardware properties (Pan, Tilt, Zoom, exposure, etc.) using a native high-speed in-memory macOS IOKit USB interface.

ports.name: Active
ports.text: Enables camera interface connection and starts background property polling.

ports.name: UVC Camera Target
ports.text: Dropdown listing dynamically discovered physical UVC camera devices connected to your system.

ports.name: Poll Rate Per Second
ports.text: Frequency (in Hz) at which current camera property values are queried from hardware.

ports.name: Camera Control Command
ports.text: A JSON payload containing camera actions to write (e.g. `{"action": "set_value", "control": "zoom-abs", "value": 10}`).

ports.name: Trigger Update
ports.text: Fires the custom command in the input JSON port.

ports.name: Trigger Out
ports.text: Trigger fired every time a polling event or command response arrives.

ports.name: Result Object
ports.text: JavaScript object containing the detailed response status/data from the last run command.

ports.name: Properties Object
ports.text: Key-value dictionary containing all active UVC control states queried from the camera.

ports.name: Running
ports.text: True if the hardware interface is successfully opened.

ports.name: Status
ports.text: Human-readable status of the hardware connection.
